Low boxwood hedging and red-leaf flax grasses frame the planting bed at the facade base. A second window with black steel frame appears at far right. Warm amber light radiates from the wall position onto the textured limestone surface, highlighting the stone's natural variation. Camera is at standing eye-level, composed off-center to the left with the doors dominating the left two-thirds and the wall surface at right occupying the remaining third. The mood is formal and dramatic, projecting polished contemporary luxury.
